description: ExaModels is an open-source software package listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "optimisation modelling language", published or maintained by exanauts (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). An algebraic modeling and automatic differentiation tool in Julia Language, specialized for SIMD abstraction of nonlinear programs. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "optimisation modelling language". It reports 87 GitHub stars and a last repository update on 2026-09-03. Implementation language: Julia. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building optimisation models for planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
